operator: RAV Raccordo Autostradale Valle d'Aosta S.p.A.
about: Italy: RAV's unit toll rates per km for 2026 (A5 Aosta-Courmayeur, all mountain), as its Carta dei Servizi 2026 (PDF, edition 05/2026, page 11) states them: 'TARIFFE UNITARIE DI RAV al 1° gennaio 2026', Tariffa montagna €/km by class; its note 2: 'Le tariffe indicate sono comprensive dell'IVA (22%) e della quota ad esclusivo appannaggio del concedente' (VAT and the ANAS fee included). Its page 12 states the 2026 increase, 1.50%. Transcribed by hand (the PDF's text layer scrambles the table); tools/tables fetches the PDF again and says if it has changed (sha256). Per class: user, euro per km, VAT and ANAS fee included, as printed (4 decimals). Note: the Ministry's 2025 sheet for RAV gives its rates in the same terms (VAT and ANAS fee included): the 2025 rates raised by 1.5% on the part net of VAT and ANAS fee give these.
